name: Toujou Hibari
source:
"I also have the right to choose"
Keyword: Perfect

A high school student.
The only daughter of the prestigious Toujou family.
She's a mature and model honor student, but in front of her relatives she has a sharp tongue and acts like a modern kid.

※Only her given name is changeable
